mentions.context_after: Closest to our setting, big-data testers generate Spark inputs by symbolic execution of dataflow operators and UDFs [ 30] or frameworkabstraction fuzzing [ 31]. Each fixes both target and technique— one query pair, one engine, or one program at a time. analysis.summary: A study of recurring correctness properties in Apache Spark, expressed as parameterised property templates. The authors use them in a dual-track framework that both proves properties in the Lean 4 theorem prover and instantiates them as executable PySpark property-based tests, reporting that templates raise agentic proof success by up to 2.6x and cut proof hallucinations by 59%.
